backup.title: Backup
backup.hint: Save your whole wardrobe to a file: items with their photos, outfits, calendar, style, shopping and settings. Keep it in Drive or email it to yourself; «Restore» brings it back to this account or another.

stats.title: Your wardrobe in numbers
stats.goodUse: You wear almost your whole wardrobe: great use of it.
stats.midUse: You wear part of your wardrobe; below is what gets forgotten.
stats.lowUse: Quite a lot of clothes never leave the wardrobe: see below what you could donate, sell or style again.
stats.forgottenHint: Donate, sell or give it another chance? Tap an item and press «What do I wear it with?».

stores.multiHint: Shops with many brands at once. Near Girona, Espai Gironès (Salt) has several chains and sports shops; El Corte Inglés and La Roca Village (brand outlet near Barcelona) are an hour away. Tick them if they suit you.

brands.hint: Brands to discover, grouped by style. They're searched on their official website (many are sold in multi-brand shops). Tick the ones you like and they'll show up in Shopping.

onb.welcome.title: Let's get to know you
onb.welcome.body: Two quick questions so recommendations are in your size and the weather is for where you are. You can change everything later in Profile.
onb.sizes.title: Your sizes
onb.sizes.body: We'll use them to recommend items in your size. Leave blank whatever you don't know.
onb.places.title: Where you are
onb.places.body: To check the weather. You can save several places and pick one each day.

item.name: Name
item.colorsHint: Up to 3, the first is the main one

style.sub: Taken from your Pinterest board and used for your outfits, suitcase and shopping.

shop.title: Shopping

access.title: Who uses the app
access.adminHint: Anyone can create an account, but they only get in once you approve it. Each person has their own wardrobe.

profile.sectionHint: Changes what the app searches for in stores and how the AI advises you. For someone else, it's better they use their own account.
